summary: Independent review rejected v1 R005_PASS because the machine gate only verified completion and field presence, not metric semantics.

blocking_defects.detail: execute_replay did not bind HypothesisSpec FOLLOW/INVERT. Replay always computed raw FOLLOW PRIOR_CLOSE_RETURN_THRESHOLD signals, and resolve_registered_metrics did not swap treatment/control. INVERT hypotheses such as r005-sr-false-breakout treated FOLLOW signal_accuracy as the treatment.

chronological_fold_diagnostics partitioned the full-window 38 signals into 12/13/13 and labeled them fold_1/2/3. The frozen plan is train_bars=20, test_bars=5, step_bars=5, embargo_bars=1. Those counts are not the V1-010 walk-forward OOS test windows.

Machine consistency used natural-language falsification_condition. r005-cu-extreme registered an aggregate comparison, had overall signal_accuracy 0.526 > 0.474 and 38 samples, but REJECT because fold 3 failed, adding an unregistered condition.

v1_gate_limitation: v1 compute_r005_gate counted complete episodes, experiment runs, four-block reports, and presence of fold_1/2/3 fields. It did not compute direction binding, treatment/control semantic mirror, authentic walk-forward fold manifests, fold-metric binding, or verdict/predicate congruence.
required_correction: Implement MVP-R-005 correction-v2 with semantic gates. Keep the v1 scorecard byte-stable. Write new runs to evidence/mvp-r-005/correction-v2/ and datasets/mvp-r-001/runs/mvp-r-005-correction-v2/. Do not check the Roadmap task complete in this round.
